verdict.rationale: Base44's docs describe automatic SSL/HTTPS once a domain is connected and easy custom-domain setup, and a community user describes going from prompt to a deployed retirement calculator with minimal ceremony, suggesting a fast publish path. However there is no explicit doc describing a single 'Publish' button/action producing a live default URL. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the exact one-click publish/deploy flow and default hosting URL, plus independent corroboration of publish speed beyond one anecdote.
